items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: I think Herb Jeffries was in one of their pictures, if I'm not mistaken.

ctx.x: Did they produce only colored pictures, or...

Well, that was a...the starting. That was the starting. They uh...first they ran the Burbank Theater at Sixth and Main for awhile and then they made the Negro picture, and I think Herb Jeffries was in one of their pictures, if I'm not mistaken. I don't know way back there but anyway, they still Popkins Productions...is in the telephone book.
And at Music Town--this is where you had your songwriting service, right?
